MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Queen, Olivia Newton-John and Rick Nelson offer familiar hits that fit my repeated interest in older pop, classic rock and greatest-hits collections.",
    "The Time-Life Christmas collection feels like a natural follow-up to A Very Special Christmas because I am currently interested in familiar holiday songs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Chicago is a musical soundtrack, while my interest right now is in familiar pop and rock songs gathered into collections.",
    "57TH & 9TH asks me to explore a studio album when I would rather revisit known hits; Elvis with orchestral arrangements interests me but needs a listen first.",
    "I cannot judge The Best ...So Far from its title because I do not know whose music it contains."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "An artist being associated with older pop or rock does not mean I want any album by that artist.",
    "My recent Christmas listening makes holiday suggestions relevant, but it does not mean I want several holiday albums on the same visit."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated choices of best-of collections suggest that recognizing the songs matters more to me right now than exploring another album.",
    "Interest does not always mean I would choose an album today: Queen takes priority over Heart, and the Time-Life collection takes priority over That's Christmas To Me.",
    "Familiar songs in unfamiliar arrangements may require sampling before I decide."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in nostalgic hits and holiday music, but sometimes confuse broad musical familiarity with wanting a particular album today."
}
